sections.title: 1. Introduction and Purpose
sections.body: The Information Security Management System (ISMS) of Apex Financial Group is established to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets supporting its digital banking, loan processing, and investment management operations.

sections.title: 2. Organizational Boundaries
sections.body: The ISMS applies to the following departments and business units within Apex Financial Group:

sections.title: 3. Geographic and Physical Boundaries
sections.body: The scope includes all information processing facilities located at:
bullets: New York Headquarters: Including the primary data center hosting core banking servers.
New Jersey Disaster Recovery Site: Hosting backup domain controllers and DR infrastructure.
Remote Workforce: Corporate-issued laptops secured through Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).

sections.title: 4. Technical and Logical Boundaries
sections.body: This ISMS encompasses the enterprise financial services ecosystem, specifically:
bullets: Identity Management: Active Directory Domain Services and Azure AD.
Core Banking Systems: Windows Server-based application and SQL servers.
Endpoint Management: Microsoft Intune and Defender for Endpoint.
Network Infrastructure: Firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, and secure LAN/WAN environments.

sections.title: 5. Exclusions and Justifications
sections.body: The following areas are excluded from the scope:
bullets: Third-party payment processors (managed under separate SOC 2 agreements).
Personal employee devices not enrolled in corporate MDM.

sections.title: 6. Stakeholders and External Dependencies
sections.body: The scope accounts for the security requirements of:
bullets: Customers utilizing online and mobile banking platforms.
Cloud Providers such as Microsoft Azure for hybrid identity services.
